text.body:
Abhidhānottaratantra ch. 33 [Tib. & Ś. 36]
= Lokesh Chandra facsimile ed.
= 1138 AD palm-leaf codex
athānyaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi vārāhyā sādhanottamaṃ |
utpattikramayogena a[¯]tmabhāvam vibhāvayet |
dvādaśārkanibhaṃ dehaṃ sindūrakṣodasannibhaṃ |
ba + kaja + prakṣyaṃ (?) trimukhaṃ ṣaḍbhujaṃ tathā |
sarvālaṅkārasampūrṇāṃ sattvaparyaṅkasusthitāṃ |
kapālamāl<ā>makuṭāṃ keśavicchuritāṃ śubhāṃ | [ 125]
vajraghaṇṭāsamāpannāṃ m-upāyodharapīḍitā |
bāṇāgaṇḍīvadharāṃ karṇāpūritakṣobhitāṃ |
kapālakhaṭvāṅgadharām aṅkuśākarṣaṇaparāṃ |
raktapadmamadhyasthāṃ sarvakāmapradāyikāṃ ||
athavā dvādaśabhujāṃ ṣaḍānanāṃ divyadehajāṃ |
ūrdhvānanaṃ ca vārāhamukhaṃ divyatejograbhiṣaṇāṃ |
pūrvapatre vajraguhyottamā [|]
vāme vajrasamayottamā |
paścime vajratejottamāṃ [|]
dakṣiṇe vajraratnottamāṃ |
agneyādau vajrajñānottamā |
naiṛtyāṃ vajravidyottamāṃ [|]
vajrasiddhottamā vāyavyāṃ |
aiśānyāṃ vajra<bha>smottamā |
dvāreṣu vajrajvālottamāṃ | vajrāmṛtottamāṃ | vajrakrodhottamāṃ | vajradraṣṭottamāṃ ||
etā devya raktavarṇās trimukhāṃ ṣaḍbhujās trinetrāḥ sattvaparyaṅkasthāḥ | muktakeśāḥ sarvālaṅkārabhūṣitā ||
vajraghaṇṭāsamāpannā svadehopāyasaṃyutāṃ |
pāśāṅkuśakapālakhaṭvāṅgadharāḥ catvāraḥ koṇe dhanuśarāpūritasthitā |
dvāreṣu ālīḍhapadasthāṃ [ 125] nagnā vikṛtānanāṃ
sarve pretāsanā<|ṃ|> vajrol[l]ālanatarjanyāṃ pāśasaṃyutāṃ |
anyeṣu anyonyavat |
yathākrameṇa parṣadi cihnavat |
taddhṛdi jñānadevyāṃ vibhāvya kāyavākcittasahitāṃ |
jñānamaṇḍalayogena dharmān samarasī bhavet |
sphurej jñānajāpeṇa (!) sa[ṃ]hāravidhivat kramāt |
samayottamajāpeṣu mantratattvaṃ ca siddhyati ||
oṃ śrīvajravārāhī āḥ baṃ hūṃ 2 phaṭ svāhā ||
oṃ śrīvajraguhyottame hūṃ 2 phaṭ svāhā ||
oṃ śrīvajrasamayottame hūṃ 2 phaṭ svāhā |
oṃ śrīvajratejottame hūṃ 2 phaṭ svāhā |
oṃ śrīvajra[ra]tnottame hūṃ 2 phaṭ svāhā |
oṃ śrīvajrajñānottame hūṃ 2 phaṭ svāhā ||
oṃ śrīvajravidyottame hūṃ 2 phaṭ svāhā ||
[...]
[...]
oṃ śrīvajrajvālottame hūṃ 2 phaṭ svāhā |
oṃ śrīvajrāmṛtottame hūṃ 2 phaṭ svāhā |
oṃ śrīvajrakroddhottame hūṃ 2 phaṭ svāhā |
oṃ śrīvajradraṣṭrottame hūṃ 2 phaṭ svāhā ||
iti yathākramena jāpabhāvanāṃ kuryāt |
saṃhārasphureṇākāraṃ sarvadharmā [ 126] hi dharmmatā+ |
svādhidevatayogātmā sarvasattvāṃ prakalpayet |
yogasthānadharmāṇāṃ triguhyenāṃ praveśayet |
triguhyālayadharmānāṃ dharmatātathatopamām |
dharmanairātmyatādharmāṃ na dharmā na ca dharmatā || ||
Abhidhānottarottare śrīguhyasamayottamapaṭalas trayastri[ṃ]śatamaḥ || ||
[ 1262']
